Officer's narrative
Officer's narrative: On arrival at the intersection in Pearland, Texas, I found two vehicles stopped at an angle to one
another. Driver 1 stated that wihle turning left across the lane of oncoming traffic, the vehicle was struck on the front
driver-side area by Driver 2, who was proceeding straight. Driver 2 gave the same account and said the collision
occurred just as described by Driver 1. Two independent witnesses on the sidewalk told me they saw the impact and
that the left turn was made in front of the approaching car. Scene photographs taken at my direction show the
damage pattern consistent with those statements. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee and was evaluated at the
scene; the type of injury is consistent with a force of this kind striking the driver's lower body against the interior. A
passenger was also seated in the front right seat and confirmed to me that they were in the vehicle at the time. Driver
1 is listed as the named insured on the policy for the vehicle involved. Driver 1 reported no prior damage to the
vehicle. Some of the body damage visbile on the rear quarter panel may not have resulted from this impact and was
not assessed further at the scene. Both drivers were cooperative, and no citations were issued at the time of this
report.
</page>
